topic: Data processing and migration for Jan 22
summary_markdown:
The session covered two main data tasks. First, a request was made to update the Japan dataset by removing coordinate filters (to cover all of Japan instead of just Tokyo) and extending the period by one day. The resulting dataset is expected to be three times larger than the original.

Second, after troubleshooting an issue with 'Percent of Forecast' for January 22, a recalculation of sessions was performed. The data in `alex_test_2` was reviewed and found satisfactory for most companies. A list of affected companies (for which data can be migrated to production) was provided. It was decided that the data from `alex_test_2` should be copied and aggregated into both `agg_5` and `agg_ml_2`, and then loaded into DataCorp.
decisions: Data for Japan needs updating: remove coordinate filters (Tokyo -> all of Japan) and extend period by one day.
The data in `alex_test_2` is approved for migration to production for the listed affected companies.
action_items: Copy and aggregate the data from `alex_test_2` into both `agg_5` and `agg_ml_2`.
Load the processed data into DataCorp.
